project.title: Native reset request, post-commit mail and callback
project.goal: Commit source-compatible reset issuance before sensitive mail handoff and offer non-consuming current-link redirect preview
project.scope: R04/R41 internal recovery chain; public acknowledgement/HTTP mail adapter/physical lifetime remain gated

boundary.responsibility: Atomic recovery issuance/audit, known-commit unlocked mail handoff and stable read-only callback preview
boundary.rationale: Recovery needs the complete internal request/link/preview/completion sequence and truthful external-effect failure states
excludes: Public origin/rate/acknowledgement mapping, concrete network mail adapter, outbox/guaranteed delivery, actual physical handle/lifetime and full provider identity

scenario.normal.description: Known request commits a one-hour source-format link and audit before unlocked mail; unknown identity acknowledges without mail; valid preview returns allowed source-compatible redirect without consumption

scenario.given: Canonical synthetic admitted control, injected clock/URL/mail dependencies
scenario.when: Request recovery and preview links through independent native/source processes
scenario.then: Known request commits a one-hour source-format link and audit before unlocked mail; unknown identity acknowledges without mail; valid preview returns allowed source-compatible redirect without consumption

scenario.refusal.description: Unready control, disabled mail, invalid email/URL/config/clock or ambiguous current link refuses without external mail or authority grant

scenario.preservation.description: Confirmed rollback restores issuance/audit; commit uncertainty withholds mail and retires handle; post-commit mail failure reports Committed and preserves possibly delivered link

action.reset_request.description: Issue a recovery link with confidential audit and post-commit mail handoff

errors.refused: NotCommitted for pre-commit refusal; OutcomeUnknown on commit error without mail; Committed/auth_delivery_unconfirmed after successful issuance but uncertain external handoff

preconditions: Caller owns actual control/workspace lifetime and injected secret/clock/origin allowlist; sender is configured and bounded
Future public mapper conceals account existence and committed-delivery details; no raw request host or authority claims
postconditions: Issuance and attempted audit atomically commit before any mail, with no transaction held at send
Known/unknown unit output has no bearer/existence field; explicit failure stage preserves truthful database and external-effect state
external_effects: Known user reset row and confidential attempted canonical telemetry/workspace audit
Only after known commit, injected mail port receives sensitive recipient/token/action URL; no new token retry or guaranteed delivery

authorization.rationale: Separate durable issuance from external delivery. No send before known commit; Committed delivery uncertainty is never rollback and must be concealed in public acknowledgement. Parsed allowlisted URLs and HMAC audit prevent redirect and secret disclosure.
